iteration_score_history.summary: Landed the first subsystem runner proof family draft with the family contract, contract-to-runner map, bounded probe contract, and observability handshake contract.
Added valid examples, invalid examples, expected-failure wiring, and validator coverage for the new family while keeping the proof state at designed_not_activated.
Added the structured subsystem-runner-proof report schema and example coverage so the slice outcome can be audited independently of prose.
Refreshed the bounded InfraNodus artifacts, emitted the final slice report plus next prompt artifacts, and aligned the ledger and ratchet report without overclaiming activation.

Executed bounded probes for intake_etl, research_harvest, and semantic_cartography. All three moved from designed_not_activated to bounded_probe_pass. Runner harnesses written for each. tool-health/status.json updated with subsystem_probes entry. wrapper_synthesizer remains gated.

infranodus_path_used.limitation: Live InfraNodus MCP analysis remains API or OAuth bound and no authenticated local runtime session was proven in this slice.

stronger_content_summary: The parent repo now has a governed subsystem-runner-proof family instead of prompt-only intent for contract-to-runner mapping, bounded probes, and observability handshakes.
Current proof states stay machine-verifiable and honest: all four subsystem lanes remain designed_not_activated while same-host runtime truth stays bounded to peer_mesh_local and inbox_protocol.
The slice now emits a structured report, markdown companion, and next-step prompt artifacts without implying subsystem activation, Pixeltable sync, DuckDB query proof, or child runtime adoption.
still_weak_content_summary: wrapper_synthesizer remains designed_not_activated (gated) — requires intake_etl + research_harvest + semantic_cartography probe artifacts + triad delegation-bundle before handoff_bundle_reconciliation probe can run.

activation_proven_same_host is the next state for all three probes — requires runner execution (not reconciliation): intake_etl needs inbox_router → ETL normalize wiring, research_harvest needs consume_source_quality_lib orchestrated call, semantic_cartography needs colbymchenry/codegraph + oxc-project/oxc installed and invoked on source-index.
live_infranodus_access is now LIVE in this session (was blocked_pass in prior iterations); this report was written before the upgrade — tool-health/status.json reflects the current live state.
pixeltable_duckdb_persistence still needs a parent-owned persistence family and bounded proof artifacts before any live sync or query claim can be made.
